'''Neighborly Town''' (Japanese: '''トナリノタウン''' ''Tonarino Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Sinnoh]]. Like many other towns in the [[region]], it is home to a [[Contest Hall]]. It was featured in ''[[DP167|Teaching the Student Teacher!]]''.

[[Top Coordinator]] [[Johanna]] was invited to join [[Raoul Contesta|Mr. Contesta]] and [[Mr. Sukizo]] in the [[Contest Judge|panel of judges]] for the town's [[Pokémon Contest]] because the local [[Nurse Joy]] was taking care of too many {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and would not be able to attend.

[[Jessie|Jessilina]] was among the several {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s participating in the Neighborly Contest, which was one of the seven remaining Pokémon Contests to be held before the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] following [[Marian]]'s announcement in ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]''. She made it all the way to the finals and was able to win the event, earning her fourth [[Ribbon]] with the help of her {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}}.
